new_records.title: Identification and structural characterization of a CBP/p300-binding domain from the ETS family transcription factor GABP alpha
new_records.overview: NMR solution structure (PDB 2JUO; BMRB 15451) and 15N heteronuclear backbone relaxation of the murine GABPα OST domain (residues 35-121). Reports isotropic tumbling time τc = 5.9 ± 0.04 ns at 30 °C, well-ordered core (36-115), and three flexible loops (61-63, 87-91, 101-104) with highest ps-ns mobility in S4/S5.
new_records.reader_notes: BMRB 15451 primary deposited paper. Per-residue T1, T2, NOE, and S2 plots are in Supplemental Figure S3 (logged under Gaps). Temperature is 30 °C (303 K) vs 298.0 K on RelaxDB card.
new_records.tables_excluded: Table 1: NMR structure restraints and ARIA/CNS ensemble statistics (not dynamics).

samples.construct: murine GABPα(35-121) with N-terminal Gly-Ser-His remnant and C-terminal non-native Trp122
samples.buffer: 20 mM sodium phosphate (pH 7.0), 50 mM NaCl, 2 mM DTT, ~10% D2O (~1-1.5 mM protein)
samples.note: Deposit lists 298.0 K, 500 MHz, pH 7.0; paper acquires spectra at 30 °C (303 K) at 500/600/800 MHz.
samples.quote: The purified proteins, with an N-terminal Gly-Ser-His remaining from the cleavage site, were concentrated to ∼ 1 to 1.5 mM in NMR sample buffer (20 mM sodium phosphate (pH 7.0), 50 mM NaCl, 2 mM DTT, ∼10 % D2O) using a 5 kDa cut-off Amicon Ultrafiltration device (Millipore). Spectra were recorded at 30 °C using Varian 500 MHz Unity, 600 MHz Inova, or 800 MHz Inova NMR spectrometers

new_records.title: PhosphoThr Peptide Binding Globally Rigidifies Much of the FHA Domain from Arabidopsis Receptor Kinase-Associated Protein Phosphatase
new_records.overview: Exact BMRB 5841 (free) and 6474 (pT868-bound) 15N relaxation (500 and 600 MHz, 25 °C) and CPMG dispersion (600 MHz, 22 °C) study of Arabidopsis KAPP KI-FHA (180-313). Free KI-FHA has τm = 7.57 ± 0.08 ns and average non-terminal S2 = 0.902; pT868 peptide binding increases τm to 10.70 ± 0.07 ns and average S2 to 0.946 while dampening ns loop motions; µs-ms exchange broadening persists across a 6-stranded β-sheet core and peaks at Ser256 (7/8 loop).

new_records.protein: Iron-sulfur cluster assembly scaffold protein IscU
new_records.title: Disordered form of the scaffold protein IscU is the substrate for iron-sulfur cluster assembly on cysteine desulfurase
new_records.overview: 2D NMR ZZ-exchange and H/D exchange on E. coli apo-IscU showing slow S <-> D interconversion (70% S / 30% D at pH 8, 25 °C; lifetimes 1.3 s and 0.50 s) and direct modulation of directional rates by 0.1 eq IscS at pH 7.5, 25 °C (S->D increases 0.77 to 1.1 s-1; D->S decreases 2.0 to 1.5 s-1). Identifies S-favoring (D39A, N90A, S107A, E111A) and D-favoring (K89A, N90D) variants.
new_records.reader_notes: Recovered from the 25 unread Nov-12 open-access PMC full-text queue. Adds direct ZZ-exchange directional rates for apo-IscU and apo-IscU + 0.1 eq IscS.

18477.bmrb_title: NMR dynamics in the C-terminal globular domain of oligosaccharyltransferase
18477.paper_title: Crystallographic and NMR evidence for flexibility in oligosaccharyltransferases and its catalytic significance
18477.access_status: paywalled_full_text (no PMCID; Elsevier Structure); companion HS-AFM paper 10.1016/j.jmb.2020.09.017 (PMID 33010307) also paywalled
18477.abstract_summary: 15N NMR relaxation characterizes solution flexibility in a mobile segment containing the +2 Ser/Thr-binding pocket of the archaeal OST C-terminal globular domain; restricting flexibility by engineered disulfide crosslinking abolishes enzymatic activity and cleavage restores activity. Companion HS-AFM study (JMB 2020, doi:10.1016/j.jmb.2020.09.017) reports two-state real-time exchange dynamics in membrane-embedded archaeal OST where sugar donor LLO shifts the equilibrium to compact state 1.

50734.abstract_summary: U14C mutant of Chlamydomonas SelW1 adopts a thioredoxin fold with an intramolecular disulfide bond (thermally stable up to 70 °C). Both reduced and oxidized forms show two additional sets of resonances for terminal residues and essentially identical dynamic behavior.
